input.code:
contract_id = input['contract_id'].to_s contract_id = 'UNKNOWN' if contract_id.empty? token = input['token'].to_s t = input['t'].to_s stored_token = input['cro_token'].to_s status = input['status'].to_s.upcase esc = lambda { |s| s.to_s.gsub('&','&').gsub('<','<').gsub('>','>') } token_ok = !t.empty? && !stored_token.empty? && t == stored_token decided = %w[APPROVED REJECTED].include?(status) # ---- shared brand header/footer ---- brand_head = %(
brightdata
BrightMind · Deal Sign-off
) brand_foot = %(
🤖 BrightMind · Bright Data · #{esc.call(contract_id)}
) if !token_ok page = %(
#{brand_head}
⚠️

Invalid or Expired Link

This approval link is no longer valid. It may have already been used or doesn't match this contract.

Please contact Deal Desk if you need to take action.

#{brand_foot}
) elsif decided page = %(
#{brand_head}
ℹ️

Already Processed

This deal was already #{esc.call(status)}. No further action is needed.

#{brand_foot}
) else submit_base = "https://apim.workato.com/brightdata/brightbot/reject-submit?contract_id=#{contract_id}&t=#{t}" page = %(
#{brand_head}
❌

Reject Deal

Contract #{esc.call(contract_id)}

You can also action this from Slack — both stay in sync.

#{brand_foot}
) end { 'html_page' => page, 'token_ok' => token_ok, 'decided' => decided }
